nodes.label: Android Splash Screen Logo (xhdpi) — default Expo placeholder icon
nodes.description: 576x576 PNG asset. The image is the uncustomized Expo/React Native default splash-screen placeholder: light-gray concentric circles (a target/ripple motif of three rings) overlaid with a faint square grid pattern, all on a white background. It is not a branded OPC logo — it indicates the app still ships the stock Expo splash icon. This file is the xhdpi-density variant of the splashscreen_logo asset for the Android build of apps/mobile.
